entries.title: ReCode: Updating Code API Knowledge with Reinforcement Learning
entries.evidence_from_enum: Its arXiv PDF, html v5, and AAAI proceedings PDF all returned as full-text hits for quoted "CodeUpdateArena" across four queries; search snippets include third-person citing descriptions of the target and report training on it.
prior_snippets: CodeUpdateArena (Liu et al. 2025) is designed to evaluate the ability of LLMs to handle API updates. The dataset comprises 670 program synthesis tasks, covering updates to 54 functions across seven different Python packages.

For CodeUpdateArena, they take the approach of training LLMs using the updated API function—using docstrings or examples—and then test if without access to the update during inference, the LLM's reflects the synthetic changes.

entries.title: GitChameleon: Unmasking the Version-Switching Capabilities of Code Generation Models
entries.evidence_from_enum: arxiv.org/pdf/2411.05830 returned as full-text hit for quoted "CodeUpdateArena" in two queries; citing-comparison sentences surfaced in snippets of the GitChameleon result sets.
prior_snippets: CodeUpdateArena valuably assesses LLM knowledge editing using synthetically generated API updates for functions in popular libraries, a different approach from using documented historical breaking changes.

CodeUpdateArena investigates model adaptation to synthetic API changes, while other approaches focus on real API changes to assess how effectively an LLM can generate code for version-specific changes of library versions that they have been trained with.
